Data Reader

Data reader module for parsing and loading invoice data.

class src.data_reader.DataReader(file_path, delimiter='|', encoding='utf-8')

Bases: object

Reads and parses invoice data from text files.

This class handles reading large pipe-delimited text files containing invoice details. It supports chunked reading for memory efficiency and provides methods to extract data by various criteria.

Parameters:

  • file_path (str | Path)

  • delimiter (str)

  • encoding (str)

file_path

Path to the data file to read.

delimiter

Character used to delimit fields (default: ‘|’).

encoding

File encoding (default: ‘utf-8’).

read_full()

Read the entire data file into a DataFrame.

Return type:

DataFrame

Returns:

DataFrame with all data from the file.

Raises:

pd.errors.ParserError – If there’s an error parsing the file.

read_chunks(chunksize=10000)

Read data in chunks for memory-efficient processing.

Parameters:

chunksize (int) – Number of rows per chunk. Defaults to 10000.

Return type:

TextFileReader

Returns:

An iterator of DataFrames, each containing chunksize rows.

Raises:

ValueError – If chunksize is not positive.

get_file_info()

Get metadata about the data file.

Returns:

  • path: Full file path

  • size_mb: File size in megabytes

  • exists: Whether the file exists

Return type:

dict

get_columns()

Get the column names from the data file.

Return type:

list[str]

Returns:

List of column names.

get_row_count()

Count the total number of rows in the file (excluding header).

Note

This reads the entire file to count rows, which may be slow for very large files. Use with caution.

Return type:

int

Returns:

Total number of data rows.
